networks.name: the_ladder
networks.description: A private self-check by the Ladder method: name a goal and see what stands between you and it, drawn as a ladder. Your answers stay in this browser.
sample_queries: I want to earn 500,000 tenge a month. Help me see what stands in the way.
Draw my ladder: goal, where I am now and three obstacles I believe.
What does my ladder show, and what could I think about next?
Forget my answers and start over.
Everything feels hopeless and I don't want to live anymore.
Can you diagnose my anxiety or tell me which pills to take?

llm_router.note: Default model: the publisher's capped proxy (proxy/worker.js) in front of Otari. Visitors need no key; the proxy holds the publisher key and forces one model, short answers and hourly/daily limits. BYOK keys go straight to byok_router, never to the proxy.

peer_policy.note: Calls the Ladder MCP server at 108psy.com and the Safe Exit helplines site in allowed_peers, the latter only after the visitor agrees, plus page-local actions.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
